title: Refunds of Credit Balances — Home Delivery Pharmacy Finance Note
content:
## Finance note: credit balances on a Home Delivery Pharmacy account

**Rule.** A credit balance larger than the program's credit-balance refund threshold is refunded to the payment method on file within the program's refund days, in calendar days of the credit balance arising; a smaller credit stays on the account and is used against the next order. On closure any credit balance is refunded regardless of size, to the payment method on file or by check when none is on file. A refund never exceeds the credit balance, so a refund may be issued only while the balance due is below zero.

### Threshold, both sides (hypothetical, threshold 10.00)

| Credit balance | Treatment while the account stays open |
|---|---|
| 10.01 | refunded to the payment method on file within the program's refund days |
| 10.00 | stays on the account and is used against the next order |
| 4.00 | stays on the account and is used against the next order |

A credit exactly equal to the threshold is not larger than it, so it stays on the account.

### On closure

| Credit balance at closure | Payment method on file | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| any size | a payment method | to that payment method |
| any size | none | by check |

### Limit of a refund

The balance due must be below zero when a refund is issued, and the refund is never more than the credit balance. A balance due of minus 18.00 allows a refund of at most 18.00.
